text: Nippon Steel Corporation publishes its top-10 shareholders as of 31 March 2026 on its Capital & Stock Data page: The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account) 13.9%, Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account) 4.0%, then custodial accounts (Chase Manhattan, JP Morgan, State Street), Nippon Life Insurance (1.8%), the Nippon Steel Group Employees Shareholding Association (1.3%), Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance (1.3%) and Mizuho Bank (1.1%).
short: Nippon Steel's top-10 holders as of 31 March 2026 are led by trust-bank accounts (Master Trust 13.9%, Custody Bank 4.0%).
